04-27-1180 is April 27, 1180.  
Adding 68 days:  
April has 30 days, so from April 27 to April 30 is 3 days.  
May has 31 days → 3 + 31 = 34 days used.  
Remaining: 68 - 34 = 34 days to add in June.  
June has 30 days, so June 30 uses 30 days → 34 - 30 = 4 days into July.  
Thus new date is July 4, 1180.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1180-07-04
